431.desc: Jet Fuel is the legendary cross of the most famous Diesel strains. By combining Aspen OG and High Country Diesel, we are left with a sativa-dominant strain that stays true to its SFV OG Kush and East Coast Sour Diesel lineage. Jet Fuel portrays sweet, pungent aromas of diesel fumes, and offers a high-energy jolt of uplifting effects that eventually levels off to provide a dream-like state of relaxation.

436.desc: Cantaloupe Dream is a sativa strain made by crossing Cantaloupe Haze x Blue Dream. Much like the name suggests, Cantaloupe is a sweet mix of tropical and citrus flavors delivering a pleasant vaping experience with an “in your face” melon sweetness. Shortly after enjoying this fantastic sativa, you will feel an energetic burst of cerebral activity and euphoria. Enjoy the vibe!
